value.name: alice watches crack documentary
value.description: Alice cries while watching a documentary about crack, visibly upset by what she is seeing.
evidence: ALICE'S & GEORGE WARD'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT. Alice cries as she watches "High On Crack Street" with George and a couple of her daughters.
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house, living room

value.name: alice sends dicky away from tv
value.description: Alice tells Little Dicky not to watch the documentary and sends him back upstairs.
evidence: Little Dicky comes in. ALICE (wiping away her tears, dialing phone) No, sweetie, go back upstairs, you can't watch this.
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house, living room

value.name: alice calls micky about dicky
value.description: Alice phones Micky to complain emotionally about what is happening to Dicky and their family.
evidence: [into phone] Micky, can you believe what they're doin' to us?
ALICE (on phone) What was he thinkin!? They set him up!
ALICE (on phone) Maybe they got the drugs for 'im an' the movie—
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house, living room

value.name: micky defends dicky then ends call
value.description: Micky, upset while watching TV, says Dicky brought the trouble on himself and then ends the call when Charlene arrives.
evidence: Micky on the phone, upset, watching HBO.
MICKY (into phone) Ma, I know, but he did it to himself.
MICKY (staring at Charlene) It's very sad, ma, I gotta call ya back. He hangs up.
value.location_hint: Micky's apartment above garage, living room/kitchen

value.name: charlene surprises micky at door
value.description: Micky opens the door to find Charlene, and they react with surprise after not seeing each other for a while.
evidence: KNOCKING ON THE DOOR, HE OPENS IT AS HE LISTENS TO PHONE—CHARLENE IS THERE. Micky's eyes widen with surprise. He hasn't seen her in a while.

value.name: micky and charlene reunite emotionally
value.description: Micky and Charlene share an emotional, awkward reunion that turns into a hug and tears.
evidence: He and Charlene stare at each other, taking it in, emotional, awkward. She laughs a little through tears. They hug. Micky crying into her shoulder and hair, Charlene holding onto him,

value.name: micky and charlene sleep together
value.description: Charlene backs Micky into his bedroom and they fall onto the bed kissing.
evidence: she backs him into his bedroom, they fall to the bed, kissing.

value.name: micky packs boxing gear
value.description: Early the next morning, Micky gathers his boxing wraps and gloves into a gym bag before leaving.
evidence: FADE OUT - FADE IN - MICKY'S BEDROOM - EARLY NEXT MORNING. Next morning. Micky's hands grab dingy white boxing wraps out of the darkness of his messy closet, faded red gloves, throws them into an old blue gym bag, leaves.

value.name: charlene wakes after night together
value.description: Charlene sits up groggy in Micky's bed and gets up wearing his T-shirt after spending the night with him.
evidence: Charlene sits up in bed, groggy, gets up in Micky's t-shirt, goes out.

value.name: micky leaves with gym bag
value.description: Micky stands at the top of the stairs with his gym bag over his shoulder, looking out at the morning as he departs.
evidence: STAIRS - MICKY'S APARTMENT ABOVE GARAGE - EARLY MORNING. Micky stands at the top of the stairs, old blue gym bag slung over his shoulder, early morning. He looks out at morning...
value.location_hint: stairs in Micky's apartment above garage
